messages:
incident-bot: HIGH: embeddings-service p99 latency spike >= 1200ms for 3m (region: us-west-2) :red_circle:
ashwin: I saw the pager, joining bridge now.
maria: on my way, grabbing logs from the service node pool.
ashwin: early hypothesis: KV cache misses spiking after the rollout last night? saw increased evictions in metrics.
kevin: @maria can you confirm eviction rate vs baseline?
maria: digging — eviction rate jumped from 3% -> 27% around 01:12 UTC. attaching quick log excerpt:
```
2026-02-28T01:12:08Z embeddings-node-7 evict key batch-3 size=8192
2026-02-28T01:12:09Z embeddings-node-7 cache-miss batch=3 seq=1024
```
ashwin: thanks. can we toggle read-through caching to reduce cold misses?
sre-lead: recommend enabling sticky routing to restored pool first, also scale up pool by +2 to relieve pressure.
oncall-bot: @ashwin you were paged for this incident (P1). Please acknowledge within 5m.
ashwin: acknowledged.
ops-bridge-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridges/1955554321 (participants: ashwin, maria, kevin, sre-lead)
kevin: I initiated a temporary cache-size bump on nodes in cluster embeddings-prod-usw2, patch applied to 3/5 nodes. monitoring for recovery.
maria: rolling back last-night rollout on embeddings-worker v2.1.3 -> v2.1.2 on remaining nodes to test if rollout correlates.
product-ops: any active customer-facing errors? need to know if this is impacting request success rates.
ashwin: error rate for generate endpoints up ~0.8% from 0.05% baseline; most are 503s due to backend timeouts. Customer impact small but rising.
sre-lead: schedule a soft page to support if (error_rate > 1.5%) and escalate otherwise.
kevin: after cache bump + rollback, p99 dropped from 1250ms -> 320ms over 4 minutes. error rate trending down.
ashwin: good. transitioning to recovery. I'm going to handoff to next oncall for monitoring and post-incident follow-up.
ashwin: Handoff notes: cause suspected cache eviction regression introduced in v2.1.3; mitigations done: cache-size bump, rollback of v2.1.3, autoscale +2. Watchlist: p99 latency, cache eviction rate, 503s.
sre-lead: assigning postmortem: owner @kevin for RCA, @maria for instrumentation log correlation, @ashwin to coordinate customer impact summary.
kevin: will own RCA. initial action items: (1) produce timeline, (2) diff configs between v2.1.2 and v2.1.3 impacting cache eviction policy, (3) run synthetic replay.
maria: I'll add detailed eviction traces and correlate to deployment tasks.
ashwin: scheduling postmortem meeting: propose 2026-03-02 15:00 UTC (30m). Does that work?
sre-lead: ok for me. @product-ops please join for customer impact notes.
product-ops: can do.
oncall-bot: @kevin you have been assigned follow-up tasks: rca-doc, timeline, and patch PR. Deadline: 2026-03-05.
kevin: noted.
ashwin: follow-up item: adjust alerting. Current alert fired on raw p99 >= 1200ms for 3m which is noisy during deploys. Proposed changes:
- add deploy suppression window where alerts are muted for 10m after rollout start
- add dedupe: only page if p99 > threshold and error_rate > 0.3%
- add predictive smoothing: use 3m rolling median instead of max
Example alert rule draft:
```
alert: EmbeddingsHighP99
expr: rolling_median(p99_latency[3m]) > 900 and increase(error_rate[3m]) > 0.003
for: 5m
labels: { severity: "high", team: "sre" }
annotations: { runbook: "docs/runbooks/embeddings_latency.md" }
```
sre-lead: +1 on dedupe and deploy suppressions, but be careful not to mask real customer-impacting regressions. We'll add an escape hatch to force a page if error_rate > 1%.
ashwin: noted. @maria please file an alert-change PR and link it to the postmortem.
maria: filing PR now -> https://git.redwood/alerts/pulls/438 (draft). includes deploy suppression flag and dedupe clause.
kevin: also opening a PR to pin cache eviction config in v2.1.x to avoid regressions: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1221
product-ops: need a short customer-facing note. ashwin can you draft a one-paragraph that we can send to impacted customers?
ashwin: will draft and share by EOD.
ashwin: final on-call handoff: @kevin taking monitoring lead for next 8 hours. escalate to @sre-lead if metrics degrade again.
kevin: taking.
ashwin: thanks team, closing the incident in the bridge.
ops-bridge-bot: Bridge closed: https://meet.redwood/bridges/1955554321 duration=00:17:09
-- Next day follow-up --
kevin: quick update: RCA draft posted: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/embeddings-1955554321 (working doc). timeline + hypothesis + perf graphs included.
maria: added traces and logs. noticed a subtle GC interaction with cache-size bump on some nodes, adding note.
sre-lead: good work. scheduling postmortem meeting confirmed: 2026-03-02 15:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).
product-ops: customer note draft: "We experienced an intermittent latency spike in our embeddings service affecting a small percentage of requests. We rolled back a deployment and applied mitigations; service performance has returned to normal. Follow-up postmortem and remediation steps will be shared."
ashwin: looks good, sent to customers in affected orgs.
kevin: Action items tracker (from postmortem doc):
- [ ] RCA finalization (kevin) due 2026-03-05
- [ ] Alert rule PR (maria) due 2026-03-04 -> PR 438
- [ ] Eviction config pin + integration test (kevin) due 2026-03-10 -> PR 1221
- [ ] Add canary + synthetic replay job (sre-lead) due 2026-03-15
- [ ] Customer communication sent (ashwin) done
ashwin: tagging for ops review: @sre-lead and @product-ops please verify that SLO adjustments and alerting changes are approved in the next weekly ops sync.
sre-lead: will add to agenda.
kevin: closing thread until postmortem meeting.
